chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a child of zina: may he be sold, purchased, and employed? He said: “Yes.”
I said: Then may she be married? He said: “Yes, and do not seek her offspring.”
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about legal dealings and marriage involving a child born from zina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person born from zina, addressing matters of sale, service, and marriage. The Imam عليه السلام permits these dealings, while adding a caution regarding seeking offspring through such a marriage.
